test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 05 Nov, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: A, C, F, E, B, U and P are sitting around a circular table facing away from the centre (but not necessarily in the same order). F is sitting third to the right of E. P is sitting third to the left of A. U is sitting third to the right of C. E is an immediate neighbour to the left of P. C is not an immediate neighbour of P. Who among the following is sitting third to the right of U?
solution: **Given: **A, C, F, E, B, U and P are sitting around a circular table facing away from the centre (but not necessarily in the same order). F is sitting third to the right of E. E is an immediate neighbour to the left of P.
